## Notes

Iron Gate Studio, published by Coffee Stain; early access 2021-02-02, 1.0 2026-09-09 with PS5 and Switch 2; seeded procedural world of nine biomes; food raises maximum health and stamina; eight bosses summoned at altars; skills to level 100; co-op up to ten players.
